name: Label meme
summary: A known photo or still where each person or object carries a small text label that gives it a role. The reader maps the roles and finds the joke. The form took off in 2017 with stock photos and cartoon stills.

philosophy.core_thesis: Let a famous picture act as a diagram: the labels give the roles, and the pose gives the joke.
design_principles: Keep the source picture whole and uncropped; use a 4:3 or 3:2 frame.
Add 2 to 4 labels in white or black boxes of 4px padding with a 2px radius.
Set labels in a plain bold sans-serif at 24px to 32px, 1 to 4 words each.
Place each label over its subject, inside the subject area, at less than 20% of the width.
Use a white box with black text, or a black box with white text; use one style in all labels.
Add a thin line or arrow from label to subject only when the target is not clear.
Keep the picture unedited; the labels are the only addition.

layout.grid_mechanics: A single picture of 800px x 600px; labels float over it at the subject positions.
layout.whitespace_ratio: The picture fills 100% of the frame; labels cover less than 15% of the area.
layout.alignment_rules: Each label sits centred on its subject; label text aligns centre.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangular label boxes with a 2px radius and 4px to 8px padding.

font_pairings.note: Arimo has the metrics of Arial, the usual face of the form.

hierarchy_rules: Use black on white boxes or white on black boxes.

color.palette_structure: The picture sets the colour; labels use black and white only.
color.contrast_rules: Black on white gives 21:1; keep the label box opaque.
color.surface_treatment: The photograph shows as shot; labels are flat boxes.
color.light_and_shadow: The light of the photograph; labels have no shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A photograph or a cartoon still with flat text boxes laid on it.
materiality.border_rules: No border on the picture; 0px to 2px border on labels.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; labels sit flat with no elevation.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin arrows or lines, 2px, from a label to a subject.
ornamentation_details.illustration: The source photograph or still; nothing else.

motion.transition_physics: Static image. A video version shows each label in turn, 400ms apart.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises a label by 2px and shows its box edge.

emotion.target_response: The viewer maps the labels, finds the roles and laughs when the pose fits.

avoid_when: The source photo shows a private person who did not agree.
The audience needs a serious tone.

modifiers.how: Remove the boxes and set white outlined capitals at the top and bottom of the picture.
Replace the photo with flat figures and use rounded label chips.
Use a stranger source picture and make each label a calm, odd phrase.

pack.why: A neutral outline family for the small arrows and pointers.

ground.why: The ground is the raw photograph; labels sit on it.
